question: The country's first commercial-scale biomass-based hydrogen plant is coming up in which district of Madhya Pradesh?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Khandwa**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The country's first commercial-scale biomass-based hydrogen plant is coming up in **Khandwa** district of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• This plant marks a significant step towards **sustainable energy solutions** and the utilization of biomass resources in India.
 
• **Biomass-based hydrogen production** offers a **cleaner **alternative compared to fossil fuels, contributing to the **reduction of carbon emissions**.
 
• The plant is expected to boost the local economy by creating jobs and promoting the use of agricultural residues and other biomass materials.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Hydrogen is considered a key element in the transition to sustainable energy systems, with applications in various sectors including transportation, industry, and power generation.
 
• India's **National Hydrogen Mission** aims to make the country a** global hub for the production and export of green hydrogen**.
 
• The government is providing incentives and support for the development of hydrogen infrastructure and technology.
 
• Biomass-based hydrogen production aligns with India's goals of increasing renewable energy capacity and reducing reliance on imported fuels.
